achv-m5b-2026-08-11.finding: ACHV's archived 8-K history has a filing with Item 5.03 (the item for amendments to the articles of incorporation or bylaws), together with Item 5.07 (matters submitted to a vote of security holders) and Item 9.01: 0001193125-26-296174, filed 2026-07-06 20:06 ET, 36 days before the 2026-08-11 release and before the window starts (2026-08-10). I did not open it: it is not one of the 47 candidates' filings, and the batch 4 permission was for wire pages only. Items 5.03 and 5.07 together could report a shareholder vote on a charter amendment (an increase in authorized shares, a name change, a reverse split), but that is an inference from the item numbers, not something I have read. What I can show: the event filing's own cover (the S2 review) records the exchange as 'Nasdaq Stock Market LLC' on the release date, the spec's identity (the CIK, ACHV, common stock, NASDAQ) is the one Milestone 1's ACHV event and batch 2's ACHV event name, the sealed dry run reports all 21 sessions of the window present and none at zero volume under that ticker, and Alpaca lists no corporate action over the window, so no split or other action falls inside it. The identity check found no other listing or charter item in the nine.
